name: paprika-recipe-manager
description: Complete Paprika recipe database management with natural language queries and write operations
long_description: A comprehensive MCP extension that provides full access to your Paprika recipe database with both read and write capabilities. Search recipes by ingredients, browse categories, view meal plans, check grocery lists, explore pantry inventory, update recipe ratings, and manage recipe categories. Features automatic database backups, transaction safety, and intelligent category management through AI-powered queries.

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Search recipes by name, ingredients, categories, or ratings with flexible filtering options

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Retrieve complete recipe details including ingredients, directions, timing, and nutritional information

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Get all recipe categories with hierarchical structure and recipe counts

tools.name: get_meal_plan
tools.description: Retrieve planned meals for specified date ranges with associated recipes

tools.name: search_by_ingredients
tools.description: Find recipes that contain specific ingredients - perfect for 'what can I make with...' queries

tools.name: get_grocery_lists
tools.description: Access grocery lists with items, quantities, and associated recipes

tools.name: get_pantry_inventory
tools.description: Check pantry stock levels and find recipes using available pantry ingredients

tools.name: get_recipe_photos
tools.description: Retrieve photo information and metadata for recipe images

tools.name: get_recent_recipes
tools.description: Get recently added or modified recipes with configurable time ranges

tools.name: get_favorites
tools.description: Retrieve user's favorite recipes with ratings and quick access

tools.name: update_recipe_rating
tools.description: Update the star rating (0-5) for a specific recipe - requires write mode enabled

tools.name: add_recipe_categories
tools.description: Add one or more categories to a recipe - requires write mode enabled

tools.name: remove_recipe_categories
tools.description: Remove categories from a recipe or remove all categories - requires write mode enabled

tools.name: update_recipe_categories
tools.description: Replace all categories for a recipe with new ones - requires write mode enabled

database_path.title: Database Path
database_path.description: Path to Paprika SQLite database file

debug_mode.title: Debug Mode
debug_mode.description: Enable detailed debug logging for troubleshooting

max_results.title: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return per query

auto_backup_enabled.title: Auto Backup
auto_backup_enabled.description: Automatically backup database before write operations
